dataset: Brazilian E-Commerce Public Dataset by Olist

grains.orders: One row per order; key order_id
grains.customers: One row per order-specific customer_id; customer_unique_id identifies repeat buyers
grains.order_items: One row per order line; composite key order_id + order_item_id
grains.order_payments: One row per payment sequence; composite key order_id + payment_sequential
grains.geolocation: Many coordinate observations per zip prefix; no unique row key
grains.product_category_name_translation: One row per Portuguese category; product_category_name

notes: The product source field product_name_lenght and product_description_lenght use this spelling in the published CSV.
Do not join raw order_items, payments and reviews directly at order grain; aggregate each child table to order_id first to prevent fan-out.
Geolocation has multiple points per zip prefix. Silver aggregates coordinates by prefix before using it as a dimension.
Raw data is not committed to this repository. Download through Kaggle CLI using the user's own local credentials.
Dataset license is non-commercial and share-alike; attribute Olist and review the Kaggle license before reuse.
